title: Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Cardholder Credit on Member Freight Pickups
content:
Cardholder benefit on the member pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership. The credit turns on the Northgate Credit Cards signature card the member holds active.

## Cardholder pickup credit

When the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus, 15.00 is taken off; when the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature, 8.00 is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

The card is the member's Northgate Credit Cards account in status active. The credit is taken off the member pickup fee whatever tender paid for the purchase; a member pickup fee that the amounts taken off would bring below zero is taken as zero.

| Active card held | Taken off the member pickup fee |
|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 15.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 8.00 |
| no active signature card (including a Northgate Store Card or a business card only) | nothing |

Hypothetical readings: a member whose Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus is active gets 15.00 off; a member whose only signature card was closed gets nothing off.
